LegalPage.title: Legal notice
LegalPage.intro: Administrative information, responsibilities and terms of use for the Talum website.
LegalPage.identityText: The Talum website is published by an independent entity and does not claim to represent a larger corporate group or a fully finalized legal structure. Official details such as the full address, SIRET, status and contact details remain to be validated before final production publication.
LegalPage.contactText: For any question or request, use the contact form on the site. Final public contact details and legal information must be confirmed before a production launch.
LegalPage.responsibilityText: Talum makes every effort to provide accurate and up-to-date information but cannot guarantee that all content is free from omissions or errors. Website content is provided for information purposes only and may change at any time without notice.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy policy
PrivacyPage.intro: The website only collects and processes information in the context of a commercial relationship and contact request.
PrivacyPage.dataText: The information transmitted via the contact form includes at minimum the name, email address, company or organization, project type and message. These data are used only to respond to the request and to continue the discussion around the need expressed.
PrivacyPage.usageText: Data is used to clarify the need, prepare a response or proposal and organize a useful exchange. It is not sold or disclosed to third parties except where strictly necessary for professional handling of the request.
PrivacyPage.rightsText: The data subject may request access, correction or deletion of their information, subject to applicable legal requirements. Final contact details and the exact personal-data handling process will be confirmed before production publication.
